scope: Technical QC only; rules frozen after schema/identity-scale inspection and before extended trace/outcome summaries. Not a biological acceptance-criteria replacement.
identity_requirements: Explicit manual target id; explicit numeric PumpProbe-to-NeuroPAL join; unique nonempty canonical name; confidence finite and in [0,1]; no nearest-position imputation. Author confidence is not independently calibrated correctness.
stimulus_artifact_exclusion: Response starts 1 s after onset, at least 0.5 s after stored 0.5 s pulse; no response-amplitude or autoresponse requirement.
baseline_requirement: F0 median finite baseline >0 and >=5 times robust baseline difference noise for fractional fluorescence use; negative samples alone do not cause whole-animal exclusion.
noise_estimator: MAD(diff(finite adjacent baseline))/0.67448975/sqrt(2). Never bridge a missing sample to estimate noise.
trial_requirement: Eligible manual high-confidence target with usable target trace and >=1 different high-confidence receiver with usable trace. Also report >=5 and >=10 receiver coverage; receiver-trial masks are retained.
exclusions: Out of bounds; overlap with another stimulus in analyzed baseline/response windows; long timestamp gap; low finite fraction; long missing run; nonpositive or low-SNR baseline; entirely flat recording ROI; missing/ambiguous/low-confidence manual target.
washout_caveat: The 10 s baseline is not assumed free of previous physiological response; report time since previous pulse and retain a separate 30 s prewindow plus 30 s prior-response-washout sensitivity from prepared audit. No claim of original sham-statistic reproduction.
